free_tier.stated: New accounts get a free 7-day trial with $5 of phone time, then $20/month; a card is required and nothing is charged for 7 days.
free_tier.notes: The $5 trial credit buys phone time at $0.06 per phone-minute. Starter is $20/month with $20 of phone time; Pro is $99/month with $99.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a cloud Android phone, not an object; an APK upload is capped at 524,288,000 bytes (500 MiB).

retention.stated: A parked phone keeps its apps, files and signed-in accounts; a saved phone unused for 30 days is deleted after a warning email a week before. Activity records are kept for 30 days.

egress.terms: not published: the pricing and limits pages read state no separate egress allowance or price for device traffic

interface_detail: REST API at https://phonebox.dev/v1 with an API key as a bearer token; CLI and TypeScript SDK in the same npm package; hosted MCP server at https://phonebox.dev/mcp.
tooling: An agent uses the REST API, the `phonebox` CLI, the TypeScript SDK or the hosted MCP server; no local emulator is needed.
chaining: A coding agent can install an APK it just built on a cloud phone and walk the screens it changed, with a browser live view for a human handoff.

limits.value: $5 of trial phone time over 7 days, then $20 of phone time a month on Starter
600 requests a minute for each API key; 60 lifecycle requests a minute for each project

limits_note: Sessions default to 15 minutes and run at most 3 hours; the phone auto-parks after about 5 idle minutes; 5 phones run at once on Starter; monthly spending limit $100 by default.
binding_note: Phone time is prepaid credit: the $5 trial week, then $20 a month, runs out before the per-minute request limit on a single agent's workload.

identity_cost.detail: Sign up with Google or an email address; the free week is new accounts only, one per person, and a card is required though nothing is charged for 7 days.

reliability_note: A phone left idle keeps billing until it auto-parks at about 5 minutes; a refused create made no phone; when fleet capacity is exhausted a create or start fails with 503 capacity_unavailable.
confidence_note: Price, credit, session limits and card gate are quoted from first-party pricing, plans, limits and signup pages read on 2026-11-25.

evidence.proved: the price is $0.06 per phone-minute, $3.60 an hour, billed per second
evidence.quote: Phonebox has one price for every phone: **$0.06 per phone-minute**, which is $0.001 a second or $3.60 an hour. Credit comes with a [plan](https://phonebox.dev/docs/billing/plans). There is no seat fee.

evidence.proved: a phone is billed per second with a 60-second minimum per session
evidence.quote: A phone is billed while it is `creating`, `starting` or `ready`, per second, with a minimum of 60 seconds for each session.

evidence.proved: the free week is 7 days with $5 of trial credit and requires a card
evidence.quote: New accounts only, one per person. Start it in the console or from the link `phonebox setup` gives your agent. A card is required, and nothing is charged for 7 days.

evidence.proved: the trial credit is $5 and the Starter plan is $20 a month
evidence.quote: - It comes with $5 of trial credit and Starter's limits. Running out never charges you; start Starter early to keep going, or choose Pro. Either ends the week and charges that plan at once, and any trial credit left carries over.

evidence.proved: signup needs a Google account or an email address
evidence.quote: Sign up with Google or your email. Start with a free week.

evidence.proved: the API is REST at https://phonebox.dev/v1 with an API key bearer token
evidence.quote: The API lives at `https://phonebox.dev/v1` and takes an API key as a bearer token.

evidence.proved: session maximum duration is 3 hours with a 15-minute default
the offer is a cloud Android device, not a phone number or SMS inbox
evidence.quote: Phonebox doesn't give your agent a phone number, an SMS inbox or calling. It gives it the device itself: the screen, the installed apps, touch input and the keyboard.

notes: The $5 trial week is time-boxed and needs a card; the recurring Starter plan is $20/month for $20 of phone time at $0.06 a phone-minute. No phone number, SMS or calling is included.

extras.billing_model: per-second prepaid phone minutes on a monthly plan
